gate_scope: Each held-out context-length group AND their token-weighted aggregate must pass every distribution/quality limit. Greedy generation differences from float are recorded, not required to match universally. Hardware must separately match the quantized reference exactly.
notes: Teacher forcing evaluates identical ground-truth prefixes, not diverging generated text.
10% perplexity ratio bounds aggregate next-token quality loss to log(1.10) nats/token.
85% top1 plus 97% top5 inclusion constrain ranking changes without demanding identity at near-tied logits.
Mean KL additionally detects a changed probability distribution even when top tokens agree.
These are project-specific finite-sample acceptance limits, not a claim of full WikiText benchmark coverage.
No calibration on held-out test data or the three frozen generation prompts; do not silently relax a failing limit.
